verdict.rationale: The product's own docs and repo say Solo 2 protects accounts with passkeys/WebAuthn, works in any USB port without drivers, and supports NFC tap-to-authenticate. That establishes the core FIDO capability, but nothing confirms working with the specific services the story names. missing for 10: explicit compatibility evidence for Google, GitHub, Microsoft and password managers, explicit U2F/CTAP1 support, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-service use.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works as a WebAuthn/U2F second factor across the major services I already use — Google, GitHub, Microsoft, password managers

citations.quote: It's a USB+NFC device that protects your accounts with passkeys/WebAuthn
Insert your Solo 2 into any USB port. No software or drivers required.
